## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 167 captures during February 2023. This activity represents the site’s imaging output for the reporting month. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and subsequent grading activity. It should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the number of referable findings identified.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 2 were recorded as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.2. This indicates that the large majority of images obtained during February 2023 were available for assessment. The ungradable results remain relevant to routine monitoring because they identify captures for which grading could not be completed.

## Grading

Grading identified 44 referable results from the activity recorded at East City Eye Clinic. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This measure provides an indication of the time taken for images to progress through the grading process during February 2023. Together, the activity, image-quality, and grading figures provide a concise view of site performance for the month.
